Audio Reverse

Reverse any audio file backwards and export it as a WAV.

⏪ Drop an audio file here or click to browse
0:00
Duration

Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Drop an audio file into the tool.
  2. Press Preview to hear it backwards.
  3. Click Download WAV to save the reversed audio.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does reversing work?

Every channel's samples are played back in reverse order, exactly like a tape played backwards.

Can I preview it?

Yes — press Preview to hear the reversed audio before downloading.

What format is the download?

A 16-bit PCM WAV.
